trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: It is high time we stop the delays.
trap.right: It is high time we stopped the delays.
trap.why: Português usa subjuntivo (“já é hora de pararmos”); em inglês o verbo vai no passado, sem valor de passado.

opts: It is high time we stop.
It is high time we stopped.
It is high time we will stop.

fix.wrong: It is high time we leave.
fix.right: It is high time we left.

fix.wrong: It is high time to we stop.
fix.right: It is high time we stopped.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “We must stop the delays now.” (high time)
rewrite.answer: It is high time we stopped the delays.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com ought to: “Society must act.”
Negativo: “It is high time we left.”
rewrite.answer: It is not high time we left.
